name: Corona Mayor's Youth Council
org: City of Corona City Manager's Office
what_you_do: Give the city a teen point of view. You learn how local government works, meet elected officials and share ideas on community decisions.
who_can_apply: You must live in Corona and go to high school in Corona. That means Centennial, Corona, Santiago, Lee Pollard, Orange Grove, or another public or private school in the city. You need a GPA of 2.0 or higher.
pay_detail: The program page does not list pay.
duration: 2026-27 school year. Meeting times are not listed.
deadline_text: Applications for 2026-27 were due Aug 31, 2026. Dates for 2027-28 are not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Fill out the youth council form. A teacher or counselor and your principal must sign it. Then give it to the Assistant to the City Manager.
notes: As of Nov 2, 2026, the new council has been picked. Next year's dates are not up yet. You can call or email to ask. Phone: 951-736-2371. Email: Melanie.Franceschini@coronaca.gov.
